column2: Table 1: Quantitative Comparison of Paper 1 (Setu et al. 2025) and Proposed Framework on Text Plagiarism Detection

Side-by-side comparison on the same held-out text test partition (N=3,000 pairs). Paper 1 = repository-audited reproduction of Setu et al. (2025), Condition A (full SBERT analysis, max(TF-IDF, SBERT), threshold 0.5000). Proposed = Condition C typed-decision tri-band pipeline. Differences follow the signed improvement convention (positive => proposed better).
Premise-disjoint train / validation / test; test partition = 3,000 pairs across 1,015 premise groups (zero premise overlap with training/validation)

Sentence-BERT all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-d dense embeddings, cosine similarity) + sublinear TF-IDF; hybrid score max(TF-IDF, SBERT); decision threshold tau=0.5000 (F1-tuned on validation); exhaustive scoring of all pairs

Typed-decision tri-band pipeline: cheap lexical Stage-1 view; calibrated SBERT Stage-2 verifier invoked only on uncertain band; validation-tuned dual thresholds (theta_low, theta_high); direct high-risk flags; Stage-2 avoided for 26.53% of pairs

Paper 1: reproduced implementation result (repository-audited, verified authentic). Proposed: proposed framework result (repository-audited, verified authentic).
